name: Vikul Saenko
source:
Symbiont: Amanita Muscaria

Vikul is a considerate and supportive friend you can always rely on. He works with Euphemia in the labs, has her back, treats her to sweet bars, and bombs her with his stupid jokes. 

Beware of his culinary delights!
